title: Assessing performance tradeoffs in hierarchical organizations using a diffusive coupling model
summary: We study a continuous-time dynamical system of nodes diffusively coupled over a hierarchical network to examine the efficiency and performance tradeoffs that organizations, teams, and command and control units face while achieving coordination and sharing information across layers.
